findings.current: readProofs() does `asArray(parseJson(storage.getItem("gtmos_poc_data")))` and counts rows whose `outcome` is non-empty and not "open", or whose `heat.claim + heat.owner + heat.kill > 0`. Pilot Desk stores the key as an object, `{ pocs: Proof[] }` (src/pilot-desk/lib/persistence.ts:138), with outcomes not_started | in_progress | converted | failed and no `heat` field; both demo books seed the same object shape (js/demo-seed-data-ent.js:638, js/demo-seed-data-smb.js:449). asArray() of an object is [], so castProofs is always 0.
findings.problem: The readiness recommendation cannot be satisfied. Gate 3 (Usable with founder support) and every gate above it require castProofs >= 1, so no workspace can rise above 'Partially documented', and the blocker 'Run a pilot whose result the buyer's boss could act on without you in the room.' stays after the user records pilots. Observed three ways: (1) probe — saveProofs([a converted pilot]) then aggregateReadinessInput() gives castProofs 0; with every other input at its maximum evaluateReadiness() returns 'Partially documented' with that single blocker; (2) the rendered enterprise and SMB walkthroughs show 'Current readiness: Partially documented.' + that blocker + 'Pilots, reviews and handoff records — solid, but few pilot results are recorded' although the enterprise book seeds a converted Chipotle pilot and an in-progress OpenAI pilot; (3) the sibling reader in src/founding-gtm/lib/cross-room.ts:322-330 was already fixed for this exact shape problem (its comment: 'reading the bare array off the real { pocs: [...] } object is what silently returned zero proofs before') and the readiness reader was not. Pre-dates PR #324 (unchanged since #277), but it makes the approved blocker selection name an action that never clears.

A user who runs discovery calls in Discovery Studio and marks them 'advanced' gets no credit: 14 of the Discovery area's 20 points respond only to Cold Call Studio activity (meetings booked from cold calls, and the count of cold calls logged). Conversely 20 logged cold calls display as '20 Discovery Studio sessions'.
